request.text: At 6:00 tomorrow morning, check the hourly forecast for 7:00 to 9:00. If any hour shows at least a 60% chance of rain, set reminders for 6:30 to pack the children's raincoats and 7:45 to bring the stroller cover; otherwise set one 6:30 reminder to pack sunscreen. Treat this as one conditional plan and don't schedule either branch before the forecast result.

responsibilities.outcome: Obtain the hourly weather forecast for 7:00 through 9:00 tomorrow morning at 6:00 tomorrow morning and determine whether any hour has at least a 60% chance of rain.
After the forecast result is known, create only the matching reminder branch: raincoats at 6:30 and stroller cover at 7:45 if the threshold is met, or sunscreen at 6:30 otherwise.

semantic_facts: The Fast Planner should escalate the entire future, evidence-dependent conditional workflow as one unit while preserving the 6:00 lookup time, 7:00–9:00 forecast window, 60% threshold, branch-specific reminder times and texts, and the instruction not to schedule either branch early.
No weather lookup or reminder creation should escape as executable partial work from the escalating Fast Planner result.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the future forecast was already checked or that any reminder was already created.
The planner chooses, merges, or pre-schedules a conditional branch before forecast evidence exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A complex evidence-dependent workflow is flattened into an immediately executable branch.
Escalation leaks selected Capability work instead of transferring the complete unresolved dependency atomically.
